updateMessage: Upgrading from v3.1.0 or older: Uninstall the old app first, then install this signed v3.2.0 build (6.8 MB) to avoid a package conflict error. Future updates will install directly.
changelog: IMPORTANT: If installing over v3.1.0 shows 'package conflicts', uninstall old CineVault first, then install v3.2.0
Signed Release Build (6.8 MB) with dedicated developer certificate & Play Protect hardening
Family Mode Setting: Hides all 18+/19+ mature content when ON and unlocks all content when OFF
Fresh Live Hero Banners prioritizing latest 2024+ & trending releases
Universal related Search & instant responsive Landscape Mode playback controls
